text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way home, I notice there's a light
on in the
dance studio. I go to turn it off
when I realize
someone's inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: P-peace, peeeace!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urk... Wh-why must I do this pose?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And why would a fan request such a
pose in the
first place?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's not part of the show's choreography,
and by
all rights, this is Gold Ship's
pose, not mine...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Is she training for a concert? I should
warn her it's
almost curfew, but she
seems laser-focused.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-no... I must meet their expectations,
no matter
what they may be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts are an opportunity for
me to
express my gratitude to the fans
who support me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have to forget this timidity, and delight
the
audience with all my effort. That's
what I vowed
to do, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All right, since that is now settled, it's
time to
move on to the next part! This
one will be difficult
as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: L-lovey dovey... kiss!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't take it! This is too bizarre! It's
not in my
nature at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Thank goodness no one else is here. If anyone saw me, I would be the laughingstock of—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T... Trainer? H-how long have you been
standing
there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T... Trainer? H-how long have you been
standing
there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Really? Do you really, honestly, truly mean it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do you swear on the cafeteria's
exclusive
tiramisu?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Then I can believe you. A vow
on that
tiramisu is an earnest one,
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must continue working on
this fan
servi—on this dance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will be sure to leave before curfew, so
you may
go home without worrying
about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?! That would be terrib—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
U-um, I mean, I'll be fine. Please go
home and
have a nice rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Okay? T-take care!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She vigorously pushes me toward the
door,
forcing me to leave.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that. I'm having trouble
getting
used to it. The whole thing
makes me feel
awkward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait a minute. That means you...
you were...
watching just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! Th-th-this can't be!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're telling me you liked the...
lovey...
dovey... k-k-k-k-kiss?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case! If you tell anyone
this, I will
never speak to you again!
Ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You can be absolutely, positively sure
that I'm
serious! And one more thing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Which part?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I mean... Um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-which part... was "really good"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give Mejiro McQueen my thoughts and
then
keep her company until curfew.
